description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01281224
Sheriff’s File # 26000274
PLAINTIFF – RRA CP Opportunity Trust 2, vs:
DEFENDANTS- Diane E. Rodre; Thomas M. Rodre; et. al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 27th day of April, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Middletown, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 1, Block 526 fka 782
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
2 Chapman Terrace Middletown, NJ 07748
Dimensions: Approximately 95X116 IRR
Upset Price: Approximately: $135,555.83 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Unknown
Nearest Cross Street: Wilson Avenue
Beginning at a point in the southerly line of Chapman Terrace, said point being south 65 degrees 50 minutes east 11.68 feet from the southeast intersection of Chapman Terrace and Wilson Avenue and running thence (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 01/28/2026; 2026 Qtr. 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $2077.22 OPEN. Sewer Acct:22362 0 11/01/2025-01/31/2026 $120.00 OPEN AND DUE 01/31/2026. Water: PRIVATE-NJ American Water Co. P.O. BOX 371331 PITTSBURGH, PA 15250 800-652-6987. General Remark: 2026 TAXES WILL REFLECT CHANGE IN ASSESED VALUE. Subject to prior mortgage recorded 11/3/2003 in Book 8294, Page 8757 currently held by Mill City Mortgage Loan Trust 2018-4 principal amount modified to $245,409.29 in 2009. Deponent does not warrant the accuracy of this representation and herein makes no representation regarding the status of title. Interested parties are advised to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether there exists any outstanding interests or amounts due.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $134,127.74.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: February 24, 2026
Frenkel Lambert Weiss Weisman & Gordon, LLP
53 Gibson Place
Bay Shore, NY 11706
